title: Senior Software Engineer (Kotlin, Java, Azure/ AWS)
description:
**Job Description**
**Create moments that matter. Decode the future.**
At the Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
  
  
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.
  
  
Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!
  
  
**All about the role:**
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Backend Engineer with proficiency in Kotlin, preferably combined with Ktor or a similar asynchronous backend framework. The candidate will become an integral part of our team working with sustainable consumer products and payments globally. You will be contributing to a large-scale, multi-regional commerce platform serving millions of consumers worldwide.
  
  
The role comes with end-to-end autonomy in application design, with a high degree of influence over architecture and implementation of the microservices being built, combined with full responsibility and ownership for their quality, scalability, deployment and lifecycle. The perfect candidate is a passionate developer who has worked with multi-regional backends and multiple platform installations across different datacenters.
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**

* A high degree of autonomy in developing new services.
* Freedom to design and shape service architecture.
* Being part of a dedicated team that values collaboration and strong engineering practices.
* Development of new capabilities on a modern, well-maintained platform with careful management of technical debt.
* Excellent benefits for future parental leave.
* A generous vacation allowance of 40 days per year.
* A flexible working environment with a well-situated office in central Stockholm

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain robust and scalable backend services primarily using Kotlin and Ktor.
* Engage in architectural discussions and contribute to the design of a multi-regional backend.
* Maintain and manage SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Integrate with search clusters such as OpenSearch.
* Work on our payment & product platform and ensure fault tolerance.
* Manage deployments with tools like Github, Gradle & CircleCI.
* Monitor built services directly in cluster and through services such as Sentry and Datadog.
* Mentor junior engineers, guiding them on best practices.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
* 3+ years of developing in Kotlin, with extensive understanding of modern and asynchronous backend frameworks.
* Worked with Kafka or a similar event streaming platform
* Fluent in git, CI/CD and build automation.
* Knowledge of how to deploy, ingress, monitor and manage backend services in a Kubernetes cluster.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with Ktor in a large-scale production environment is a major qualifier.
* Hands-on experience and understanding of payment platforms is advantageous.
* Familiarity with AWS and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform/Terragrunt.

**Where you'll be:**
This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India
  
  
**As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.**

title: Software Engineer III -  Mobile (Android/iOS) Developer
description:
**Job Description**
We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Asset and Wealth Management Technology team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You will be a core technical contributor across multiple business functions, with native Android/IOS skills.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and troubleshoot native mobile solutions beyond routine approaches.
* Deliver end-to-end features for Android apps and supporting services, contribute to iOS features and maintenance as needed.
* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Apply strong engineering practices (domain modeling, clean structure, testability, evolution).
* Write secure, high-quality production code; review and debug others' code and build and maintain robust Android architecture (e.g., Clean Architecture, MVVM/MVI) focused on performance and reliability.
* Build reusable UI components/design systems; modernize legacy code where needed and integrate with back-end systems via RESTful APIs/JSON, partner with platform/API teams on scalability and security.
* Improve operational stability by eliminating recurring issues and automating remediation.
* Own production health: investigate crashes/ANRs/perf/auth issues and prevent recurrence and keep platforms current (OS/dependency upgrades, security patches) and support safe, low-downtime releases.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Software development experience (design, build, test, and production support), including significant native Android work.
* Experience in Kotlin, Android SDK, Gradle (including multi-module), Coroutines/Flow, Jetpack (e.g., ViewModel/Lifecycle/Navigation/Paging), Compose (Material 3) and XML Views, DI/networking (e.g., Hilt, Retrofit/OkHttp), performance and crash/ANR analysis.
* Working knowledge of Swift, Xcode, SwiftUI/UIKit; ability to deliver fixes/features and participate in code reviews while keeping cross-platform behavior consistent.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Experience with distributed systems and mobile networking patterns (REST/JSON).
* Strong understanding of mobile data persistence/caching/offline patterns; familiarity with SQL/NoSQL through service layers.
* Strong fundamentals in mobile security, secure storage (Keystore/Keychain), encryption in transit, certificate pinning, biometrics/modern auth, minimizing sensitive-data exposure.
* Experience in logging, monitoring, analytics, crash reporting, performance analysis with observability/production readiness
* Experience in CI/CD and automated testing (e.g., JUnit/Espresso/Compose UI; XCTest) with Agile/Scrum experience and strong SDLC discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Regulated-domain experience (banking/financial services) and security-sensitive mobile products.
* Stronger iOS depth (Combine, Swift Concurrency, SPM, Instruments).
* Passkeys/FIDO, mobile app hardening/runtime protection.
* Modern release practices (feature flags, staged rollouts; Play Store/App Store processes).
* End-to-end mobile test automation, push notifications, and familiarity with code quality/security scanning tools.
* Cloud/observability exposure (e.g., AWS); AWS certification a plus.

**ABOUT US**

title: iOS Developer
description:
**The team:**

Customer has to do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long-term growth. Learn more about: Customer

**Key Responsibilities:**

Flutter Engineer – iOS Native & Flutter

Experience: 3 – 8 Years

Role: Flutter Engineer – iOS Native Integration

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a skilled Flutter Engineer with strong hands-on iOS Native development experience to design, develop, integrate, and maintain high-quality mobile applications.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Flutter/Dart as well as iOS native development using Swift, with proven experience integrating Flutter applications with native iOS components, SDKs, platform services, and third-party libraries.

The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, with particular emphasis on Clean Architecture, Secure Coding, Application Security, Encryption, Performance, Native–Flutter Interoperability, and complex SDK integration.

* Design and develop scalable mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
* Develop and maintain iOS native components using Swift.
* Build robust Flutter-to-iOS Native integrations using:

* Method Channel
* Event Channel
* Basic Message Channel
* Custom Flutter plugins

* Integrate native iOS SDKs and third-party frameworks into Flutter applications.
* Develop Flutter plugins/wrappers for native iOS capabilities where required.
* Analyze and troubleshoot issues across the Flutter, Dart, iOS, and native SDK layers.
* Design applications using Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, design patterns, and modular architecture.
* Implement secure coding practices across Flutter and iOS native layers.
* Integrate authentication, payment, security, analytics, monitoring, biometric, and other enterprise SDKs.
* Optimize application performance, memory usage, startup time, network usage, and UI responsiveness.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving Flutter ↔ iOS ↔ SDK ↔ Backend interactions.
* Implement unit, widget, integration, and native-layer tests.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding and architectural standards.
* Collaborate with architects, backend engineers, QA, DevOps, security teams, and product stakeholders.
* Contribute to technical design, estimation, documentation, and engineering best practices.

**Preferred / Good to Have:**

* Experience in Banking, FinTech, Payments, UPI, or other security-sensitive applications.
* Experience migrating or integrating existing native iOS applications with Flutter.
* Experience developing Flutter plugins.
* Strong Swift concurrency knowledge.
* Experience with UIKit and SwiftUI.
* Experience with Firebase/App Distribution/Crashlytics or equivalent.
* Experience with performance profiling and memory-leak analysis using Xcode Instruments.
* Knowledge of mobile application threat modelling.
* Experience with App Attest, DeviceCheck, Secure Enclave, and advanced iOS security mechanisms.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience with CocoaPods and/or Swift Package Manager.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for Flutter and iOS applications.
* Experience troubleshooting dependency, signing, provisioning, and build issues.
* Understanding of Flutter iOS build and release processes.
* Experience managing different environments/flavors/configurations is desirable.
* Unit testing using XCTest and appropriate Flutter/Dart testing frameworks. Widget and integration testing. Mocking and dependency isolation.
* Experience debugging production issues using logs, crash reports, stack traces, and performance tools.
* Familiarity with Xcode Instruments for performance and memory analysis.
* Strong understanding of code quality, static analysis, and code review practices.

**What We Expect:**

* The candidate should be an engineer who can work across both Flutter and iOS Native layers, rather than a Flutter-only developer.
* They should be able to independently investigate an issue that starts in Flutter, crosses a platform channel, enters Swift/Objective-C, interacts with a third-party SDK, and identify and resolve the problem end-to-end.
* Strong emphasis will be placed on hands-on technical capability, iOS native expertise, Flutter integration, architecture, security, SDK integration, debugging, performance, and problem-solving skills.

**Location and way of working:**

* Base location: Bengaluru
* Notice period : Immediate - 15 days max
* Education: Professional Qualification - B.E./B. Tech/MCA/MBA/MS
* Mode of working - WFO

title: Android Developer Lead
description:

You will work on hard, meaningful problems that help generations build wealth. We move fast, think clearly, and give you complete ownership to build products that transform lives for millions of global investors.

**The Opportunity:**

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead the development of our Android app, building experiences that make deep financial research accessible and actionable for every investor.
* Architect and ship features that turn complex financial data into clear, actionable experiences for retail investors.
* Set coding standards and own technical decisions that keep the app performant, reliable, and scalable as we expand into new product verticals.
* Work closely with AI, data, and product teams to bring intelligent, research-backed features to life on mobile.

* Proven expertise of 4+ years in Android app development.
* Proficiency in Kotlin and modern app development frameworks.
* Experience building data-rich, real-time features - ideally in fintech or advisory products.
* Leadership skills and the ability to communicate clearly across technical and non-technical teams.
* Bonus points for prior work on recommendation engines, personalization, or financial advisory tools!

**You Fit the Bill If:**

* You're a quick learner who can work independently in a fast-moving environment.
* You care deeply about user trust - especially when users are making real financial decisions.
* You thrive when shipping is critical and quality cannot be compromised.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Leucine And Celestara**

**12 of the top 15 generic pharma companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.**

Leucine builds AI-powered software that helps pharmaceutical manufacturers stay compliant, audit-ready and productive, so medicines reach patients faster. Manufacturing, QA and QC teams use Leucine across thousands of regulated workflows, from material receipt to batch release, for small molecules, biologics, vaccines and more.

Celestara is our platform for building and running those solutions: data pipelines, agnotology that models the customer's operations, agentic workflows and applications on top.

**About The Role**

You will sit with our customers, understand how their work really gets done, and turn their highest-value problems into live solutions on Celestara. You own each use case end to end: from discovery and business case, through design and build, to UAT, go-live in production, and then its adoption, maintenance and ongoing iteration.

This is a hybrid role. Think product manager, solution architect and hands-on builder in one person, working inside the customer's four walls rather than from a distance. Most of our customers are in pharma, but you do not need prior pharma experience. We care far more about curiosity, empathy for users and the ability to learn a new domain fast.

**Location - India and United States, deployed on-site at customer locations**

**What You'll Do**

Understand the problem

* Embed with customer teams on the shop floor, in QA/QC labs and in offices; shadow users and learn how work actually happens
* Run discovery workshops and interviews; build empathy for users' pain points, constraints and incentives
* Produce clear as-is process maps: steps, roles, hand-offs, systems, data sources and where time, cost and errors pile up

Build the business case

* Run ROI assessments: baseline current effort, cycle time, error and rework rates, and quantify the value of the future state
* Prioritise use cases with the customer by value, feasibility and time to impact

Reimagine the solution on Celestara

* Design the to-be process and solution in the context of the platform, not as a one-off workaround
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data sources and transformation pipelines, ontology and data model, agentic workflows, application screens and user journeys, integrations and access controls
* Write crisp specs and user stories; make trade-offs and say no when scope does not serve the outcome

Deliver from UAT to production

* Configure and build on Celestara, hands-on, working with our product and engineering teams for anything new
* Plan and run UAT with customer users; triage feedback, fix issues and drive sign-off
* Lead go-live, hyper care and adoption; measure the outcomes against the ROI baseline
* Support validation and documentation needed in a regulated environment, with help from our domain experts

Own the use case after go-live

* Drive adoption: train users, track usage and close the gaps that stop people from relying on the solution
* Maintain the use case in production: monitor pipelines, workflows and agents, resolve issues and manage changes under the customer's change-control process
* Iterate continuously: gather feedback, measure impact against the ROI baseline and ship improvements release after release

Be the voice of the customer

* Feed field insights back to product: patterns across customers, gaps in the platform, ideas for reusable components and templates
* Build trusted relationships with users, process owners and senior stakeholders; identify the next use cases to expand into

**Requirements**

**What we're looking for**

**Customer and problem obsession**
. You listen first, ask sharp questions and can explain a user's problem better than they can.

**Product thinking.**
Experience as a product manager, solutions consultant, business analyst or similar; you can go from a messy problem to a prioritised, well-specified solution.

**Process and value analysis.**
You have done as-is/to-be process mapping and can build a credible ROI or business case with real numbers.

**Technical fluency.**
You already understand, or can quickly learn, how modern data and AI platforms fit together:

* data integration, transformation and pipelines (ETL/ELT)
* data modelling and ontologies (entities, relationships, semantics)
* agentic and LLM-powered workflows, automation and orchestration
* application design: user journeys, screens, roles and permissions
* APIs and enterprise system integration

**Hands-on builder.**
Comfortable configuring a platform, writing SQL, and scripting (e.g. Python) to get things working; you do not wait for someone else to build.

**Delivery ownership.**
You have taken work through UAT and into production and stayed accountable for adoption and outcomes.

**Communication.**
Clear written and verbal English; equally at ease with an operator on the floor and a VP in a steering committee.

**Ready to be on the ground.**
Willing to be deployed at customer sites in India or the US and travel as needed.

**Fast learner**
. Comfortable picking up a complex, regulated domain like pharma manufacturing and quality. No prior pharma knowledge required.

**Nice to have**

* Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or implementation lead at an enterprise SaaS, data or AI platform company
* Exposure to platforms built on ontologies or semantic layers, or to low-code/no-code application builders
* Hands-on work with LLMs, prompt design, RAG or agent frameworks
* Background in manufacturing, life sciences, quality or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV/CSA)
* An engineering, computer science, data or operations degree, or equivalent experience
* 3-8 years experience (indicative; strong builders with less are welcome)

**Benefits**

**What success looks like**

* By 30 days - Learned Celestara hands-on, shadowed a live deployment and grasped the basics of pharma manufacturing and quality workflows
* By 90 days - Owned discovery for a customer use case: as-is map, ROI case and a Celestara solution design the customer has signed off
* By 180 - days Taken at least one use case through UAT into production, with measurable adoption and impact, and identified the next use cases with that customer

**Why join us**

* Real impact. Your work helps medicines get made right and reach patients faster. Ownership. You own outcomes, not tickets, with direct access to customers, product and leadership
* Breadth. Product, data, AI and operations in one role; a fast track into product leadership, solution architecture or customer leadership
* Frontier tech in the real world. Put agentic AI and ontology-driven applications into production in one of the most demanding industries

**Other Benefits**

* Market leading compensation + uncapped variable
* Opportunity for fast-track growth & leadership
* Work with a purpose-driven, global team transforming an essential industry
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Advisor / Senior Solution Architect to

serve as a senior individual contributor and technical subject matter expert across strategic

customer engagements.

This is a hands-on role that spans both the sales and delivery lifecycle. The successful

candidate will lead technical solutioning, build critical components, resolve complex

implementation challenges, and remain accountable for the technical quality and successful

delivery of assigned customer solutions.

The role requires strong experience in low-code platforms, enterprise architecture, integrations,

hands-on application development, customer-facing solutioning, and technical delivery

ownership. The individual will also mentor the broader technical team and help strengthen

delivery capability, standards, and execution quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture & Development**

* Lead the end-to-end technical solution for strategic and enterprise customer engagements
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable applications and workflows
* Design and build complex low-code applications, workflows, integrations, data models, reports, and automation components
* Develop prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and reusable components
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex functional, technical, integration, performance, and security issues
* Establish development standards, reusable patterns, and implementation best practices

**Technical Delivery Accountability**

* Own the technical solution from pre-sales handover through implementation and go-live
* Ensure delivered solutions align with agreed business requirements, architecture, scope, and platform capabilities
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and delivery constraints early in the engagement
* Work closely with project managers and delivery leads to track progress, risks, and milestones
* Take ownership of technical escalations, working directly with internal teams and customers to resolve them
* Ensure successful handover, documentation, and knowledge transfer

**Pre-Sales Solutioning**

* Partner with sales and account management during opportunity discovery and solution qualification
* Lead technical discovery workshops covering business processes, systems, integrations, and security requirements
* Build proof-of-concepts and prototypes to validate proposed solutions
* Contribute to proposals, statements of work, effort estimates, and implementation roadmaps
* Communicate platform capabilities, limitations, and delivery risks clearly to customers
* Identify potential expansion opportunities based on customer needs and platform capabilities

**Project & Engagement Support**

* Take ownership of selected customer projects or technical workstreams as needed
* Support project planning, milestone definition, risk tracking, and status reporting
* Manage a limited number of smaller projects alongside hands-on solution responsibilities

Team Growth & Mentoring

* Mentor solution architects, technical consultants, and developers through pairing and hands-on coaching
* Create reusable solution patterns, development standards, templates, and technical documentation
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and technical evaluation of team members

Required Experience

* Significant experience as a solution architect, technical architect, senior developer, or technical lead
* Strong hands-on experience building enterprise applications on low-code/no-code platforms such as Kissflow, Microsoft Power Platform, OutSystems, Mendix, Appian, ServiceNow, Salesforce Platform, or similar
* Proven experience leading technical solutioning across both pre-sales and delivery stages
* Strong application development experience — workflow design, data modeling, business rules, UI, integrations, reporting, and automation
* Strong knowledge of enterprise integrations, REST APIs, web services, identity and access management, databases, and cloud platforms
* Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues through testing, deployment, and production stabilization
* Experience contributing to proposals, statements of work, estimates, and implementation plans
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills — able to work with business stakeholders, IT teams, and senior customer leaders
* Experience mentoring technical team members while remaining an individual contributor

title: Principal Engineer (Mobile)
description:
**About Neo**

AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value. Neo is changing that.

Founded by
**Bhavin Turakhia**
— Co-Founder of
**Zeta**
,
**Radix**
, and
**Titan**
—
**Neo**
is building an integrated, AI-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first-class participant in every workflow:

Tasket — A radically reimagined, AI-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.

Friday — AI Assistant, co-worker and agent platform, pre-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000+ SaaS platforms.

Studio — AI-native suite for co-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.

Scribe — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note-taking and actually does your work while on the call

**About the role**

As a Mobile Engineer you will build and ship features across the Neo suite's React Native and Flutter apps — the surfaces where people carry Tasket, Friday, and Scribe in their pocket.

We are proponents of leveraging best-in-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle — design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of senior, hands-on, AI-adept engineers, resulting in ultra-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will work within this approach, from design through to production.

You'll own well-scoped components end to end — from a feature's UI down to how it behaves on a real device — and grow your judgment on the trade-offs that only show up once something ships.

**Responsibilities**

**Build**

* Build features across Neo's cross-platform apps (React Native / Flutter) — the interfaces where people delegate work to Friday and pick up Tasket, Studio, and Scribe on the go.
* Take a spec to a shipped feature by directing agents through implementation, then reviewing the result against device behaviour, not just the simulator.

**Architecture & systems judgment**

* Own components and screens end to end — state management, navigation, and how they hold up under real network and device conditions.
* Contribute to design discussions on offline behaviour, sync, and app performance.

**Agent leverage**

* Use agents to move from spec to working UI quickly, then validate the output by hand against the craft and correctness bar.
* Structure well-defined tasks — a screen, a component, a bug — so agents can execute them reliably.

**Quality & ownership**

* Own performance and correctness on real devices — startup time, jank, memory, and behaviour across OS versions and screen sizes.
* Triage and fix crashes and platform-specific issues; keep release quality high across app store submissions.

**Skills**

* **AI-native engineering practice**
  — Comfortable directing coding agents against a clear spec and validating their output against device-level reality, not just what compiles.
* **Cross-platform mobile fundamentals**
  — Solid command of React Native/TypeScript (preferred) or Flutter/Dart, including state management, navigation, and the native bridge/platform-channel layer when you need to drop below the framework.
* **Native platform awareness**
  — Working knowledge of Android and iOS build, release, and permissioning models — enough to debug a platform-specific issue without waiting on a native specialist.
* **Performance & reliability**
  — Reasons about startup time, rendering performance, offline/sync behaviour, and memory use on real, low-end devices, not just flagship hardware.
* **API integration**
  — Comfortable consuming REST/GraphQL APIs, handling auth, and building resilient network and caching layers for a mobile client.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 7+ years building and shipping production mobile apps
* 2+ years in React Native (preferred) / Flutter, or equivalent cross-platform frameworks.
* Have taken at least one app through real app-store release and iteration cycles.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical depth.

**Equal Opportunity**

Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Mobile App Development
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Patient Care Solutions Mobile Center of Excellence (Mobile CoE) is focused on building secure, scalable and high-quality mobile solutions while establishing reusable capabilities, engineering patterns and development practices that can be adopted across multiple products.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer is a strong hands-on technical contributor responsible for the design, development, testing and delivery of mobile application features and shared mobile capabilities. The role works closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, UX, Security, DevOps and engineering teams to deliver solutions aligned with Mobile CoE architecture and engineering standards.
  
  
The individual should have strong mobile engineering fundamentals and demonstrate expertise in mobile architecture, performance, security, observability, automation, CI/CD, AWS cloud-integrated development and AI-assisted software engineering.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test and deliver high-quality mobile application features, reusable components and shared capabilities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Tech Leads and UX teams to understand requirements, assess technical feasibility and translate requirements into implementable solutions.
* Participate actively in technical discussions, design reviews and architecture decisions, bringing a strong mobile engineering perspective.
* Apply established Mobile CoE architecture patterns, coding standards and engineering practices, while contributing improvements based on implementation experience.
* Build reusable mobile components, libraries and common capabilities that can be adopted across applications where appropriate.
* Maintain high code quality through clean design, code reviews, unit testing, automated quality checks and secure coding practices.
* Understand the end-to-end application architecture, APIs, AWS services and integrations while developing deep expertise in assigned components.
* Analyze and improve mobile application performance, reliability, security and user experience using appropriate profiling, diagnostics and engineering practices.
* Implement appropriate mobile security practices including authentication, authorization, secure storage, session/token management and protection of sensitive data.
* Build appropriate logging, telemetry, crash reporting and observability into mobile applications to support troubleshooting and operational monitoring.
* Contribute to automated build, test, CI/CD and release processes and continuously improve engineering efficiency.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues, participate in root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective solutions.
* Adopt an AI-first engineering mindset, using AI-assisted tools throughout the SDLC for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test generation, code understanding, technical documentation and developer productivity.
* Identify opportunities to use AI to automate repetitive engineering activities, accelerate development and improve software quality, while ensuring appropriate human review and validation.
* Apply responsible AI-assisted development practices, ensuring generated code and recommendations are reviewed for correctness, security, maintainability and compliance.
* Share technical knowledge, reusable solutions, AI-enabled engineering practices and implementation learnings across the Mobile CoE.

**Desired Technical Skills / Experience**

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience, preferably 7+ years, with significant experience in mobile application development.
* Strong experience with one or more modern mobile technologies such as Flutter, React Native, iOS/Swift or Android/Kotlin.
* Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, design patterns, state management, navigation, application lifecycle and API integration.
* Experience building reusable mobile components, SDKs, libraries or shared capabilities across applications.
* Strong knowledge of mobile application performance optimization including startup, responsiveness, memory/resource utilization and network performance.
* Good understanding of UX principles, accessibility and mobile design systems.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, secure storage, encryption, session/token management and secure mobile development practices.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs and AWS-hosted backend services.
* Experience with automated testing including unit, integration and mobile UI automation.
* Experience with mobile build automation and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with logging, telemetry, crash reporting, diagnostics and application performance monitoring.
* Working knowledge of AWS and cloud-integrated mobile architectures, with an understanding of reliability, performance, security and cost-conscious engineering.
* Experience with static code analysis, security scanning and vulnerability remediation.
* Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe software development practices.
* Strong practical experience using AI coding assistants and AI-enabled engineering tools for coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, documentation and code review support.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions rather than accepting generated code by default, with appropriate attention to security, quality, maintainability and accuracy.
* Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer productivity, engineering automation and software quality.
* Exposure to building or integrating AI-enabled application capabilities is an advantage.
* Experience developing healthcare, regulated or security-sensitive applications is preferred.

**Mobile CoE Mindset**

* Think beyond a single application and identify opportunities for reuse and standardization across mobile products.
* Prefer common patterns and shared capabilities over application-specific solutions where appropriate.
* Contribute implementation learnings back into Mobile CoE standards, reference patterns and engineering practices.
* Help improve developer productivity through automation, AI-assisted engineering, tooling and common development practices.
* Collaborate across product teams to encourage consistent approaches to architecture, security, quality, performance and observability.
* Experiment with emerging mobile and AI engineering technologies, evaluate their practical value and help bring useful practices into the CoE.
* Share reusable approaches and engineering learnings so that improvements made for one product can benefit other mobile teams.

**Preferred Professional Training And Certifications**

* Professional training or certifications related to iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native or other relevant mobile technologies.
* AWS cloud fundamentals or developer certification.
* Training or certification related to AI-assisted software development, application security, DevOps, Agile or software architecture is an advantage.

**Desired Professional Characteristics**

* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently deliver complex technical assignments.
* Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across Product, Architecture, UX, Security, QA and DevOps teams.
* Proactive in identifying technical problems and proposing practical solutions.
* Willingness to share knowledge and support other engineers through technical discussions and code reviews.
* Curious and experimental mindset toward AI and emerging engineering technologies, balanced with sound engineering judgment.
* Continuous learning mindset with interest in advancing mobile, AWS and AI-enabled software engineering practices.

Senior Mobile Engineer

**Function:**
Mobile Engineering

**Location:**
Embassy Tech Village, Bellandur, Bangalore (Hybrid)

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Marketing Research, Data & Consumer Insights

**About Company**

The company is a leading marketing research and data insights firm with over 25 years of experience. It operates one of the world's largest consumer research networks — 130 million global panelists.

The company combines survey data, digital behavior, and purchase data to deliver actionable insights. It serves approximately 2,500 domestic and 1,500 overseas companies across Asia-Pacific.

Backed by ~$848 million in funding, the company is in an active growth and expansion phase. Its agile, transparent, and ownership-driven culture encourages innovation at every level.

**Position Overview**

The company is seeking a Senior Mobile Engineer to lead the ground-up rebuild of its consumer panel mobile app using React Native. The role spans the full product lifecycle — from architecture decisions and UX discussions to CI/CD pipelines and App Store releases — while ensuring a seamless transition from the existing legacy app for millions of panelists across Asia-Pacific.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Build a new mobile app from scratch on a modern, scalable architecture using React Native, while analyzing the existing legacy app to ensure functional parity for current users
* Take full ownership of technology selection, critical architectural decisions, and driving continuous improvement of the codebase
* Lead the full lifecycle from UX discussions and technical design to implementation, testing, and production rollout
* Own the mobile CI/CD pipelines (Fastlane, GitHub Actions) and manage the entire app store submission process for both iOS and Android
* Ensure crash-free session rate ≥ 99.5% and ANR within industry norms through robust observability and crash reporting using Sentry and Firebase

**Must Have Criteria**

* 7–12 years of professional experience in mobile application development
* Deep production experience with React Native, with the ability to drop into native iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) for bridge modules, background tasks, and OS-level performance issues
* Strong understanding of modern architecture patterns — MVVM, MVP, and Declarative UI — applied in production mobile applications
* Proven experience building mobile applications from scratch on modern stacks, with the ability to analyze and interpret legacy codebases to ensure functional parity
* Experience building automated testing suites covering Unit, Integration, and E2E tests to ensure production-ready code quality
* Expert knowledge of CI/CD for mobile, including Fastlane, code signing, provisioning profile management, and managing automated releases to the App Store and Play Store

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in Agile development environments with iterative sprint-based delivery
* Experience collaborating on UX design and applying user-centered design principles in mobile product development
* Proven track record of optimizing mobile performance — app size, startup time, rendering speed, and memory footprint
* Hands-on experience with mobile accessibility standards (VoiceOver on iOS, TalkBack on Android) and internationalization (i18n/l10n)
* Strong working knowledge of design systems and component libraries applied in a React Native codebase
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field

**What We Offer**

* Rare greenfield opportunity to architect and build a consumer app used by millions of panelists across Asia-Pacific
* High ownership and autonomy — you drive technology decisions, not just implement them
* Hybrid work model based out of Embassy Tech Village, Bellandur, Bangalore
* Exposure to large-scale data systems combining behavioral, survey, and purchase data
* Growth opportunities within a global organization

title: Senior Software Engineer - iOS
description:
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer - IOS (IC3) to join Procore’s mobile engineering team, working on the Drawings tool and the Unified Viewer on iOS. In this role, you’ll drive the technical evolution of how field and office teams open, compare, and annotate large technical documents on their phones and tablets, often offline. Your primary goal is to design, build, and operate fast, reliable, offline-first solutions while using AI-assisted engineering practices to raise the speed and quality of delivery.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll partner with product managers, designers, and Android, web, and backend engineers to deliver features on a shared viewing and annotation foundation, and mentor team members on technical craft. Use your iOS architecture, concurrency, and performance expertise to turn heavy, disconnected content into a smooth experience for job sites worldwide. Join us to transform construction technology. Apply today!
  
  
This position reports into Mihir Patel and will be based in our Bengaluru Office. We’re looking for someone to join immediately.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architectural Leadership: Design, build, and maintain iOS applications across the Drawings tool and the Unified Viewer. Lead complex architectural evolution while balancing operational delivery with long-term system performance.
* Feature Execution & AI Integration: Own feature lifecycles end-to-end, from technical design through staged rollout. Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery while applying engineering guardrails to maintain code quality.
* Offline-First Data & Sync: Build and improve sync, download, and annotation flows that stay correct on poor connectivity, covering concurrent sync modes, accurate progress, durable upload queues, and local state that matches what’s on disk.
* Testing & Reliability: Define test strategies and acceptance criteria before implementation, including unit, snapshot, and concurrency-deterministic tests, to ensure graceful degradation and smooth feature flag rollouts.
* Observability & Performance: Instrument features with analytics and telemetry. Diagnose main-thread stalls, memory pressure, and crashes using Instruments and crash reports, and fix them at the root cause with measured results.
* Technical Clarity & Documentation: Document technical decisions, keep module boundaries and routing conventions consistent, and align with Android and web on shared contracts such as annotation geometry.
* Mentorship & Quality: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through detailed code reviews, architectural guidance, and best practices in modern iOS development.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Experience: 5+ years of professional iOS development in Swift, shipping and maintaining a large production app.
* Tech Stack Expertise: Strong UIKit and SwiftUI, deep Core Data knowledge (context and queue discipline, fetched results controllers, batching), and Swift concurrency (actors, Sendable, main-actor isolation) alongside Combine.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, a related STEM discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Engineering Impact: Track record of building offline-first or sync-heavy features, including cancellation, prioritisation, and failure handling, and of improving reliability and performance in a large modular codebase.
* Problem Solving & Communication: Strong debugging and profiling skills, and the ability to explain complex designs clearly to cross-functional partners.
* Mindset: Adaptable and growth-oriented, comfortable working across legacy and modern code and across product domains.
* Preferable: Experience with PDF or document rendering SDKs, canvas or coordinate-space math (rotation, zoom), deep linking and QR scanning, SQLite and full-text search, iPad multi-window layouts, or Objective-C. A background in construction or field-work software is a plus.

title: Senior iOS SDK Engineer, Objective-C
description:
**Who We Are**
Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are an iOS SDK engineer who builds code that runs inside other companies’ apps, not someone who mainly builds apps or integrates third-party SDKs. You’ll work on Verve’s HyBid iOS SDK, where the code has to stay lightweight, backward-compatible, and safe in host apps we don’t control. The SDK combines legacy Objective-C with modern Swift, so you’ll work in both every day. The focus is stability, Objective-C/Swift interoperability, framework packaging, and memory and thread safety.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop, maintain, and improve core modules of Verve’s iOS HyBid SDK, with a focus on stability, performance, memory safety, thread safety, and backward compatibility.
* Work hands-on with Objective-C and Swift across networking, ad rendering, mediation, tracking, and SDK integration flows.
* Build, validate, and maintain SDK packaging and distribution through SPM, CocoaPods, .framework, and .xcframework, and lead the CocoaPods to SPM migration.
* Troubleshoot complex SDK issues inside third-party publisher apps, including crashes, memory leaks, threading issues, dependency conflicts, and integration edge cases.
* Build and optimize ad rendering and mediation integrations, including AppLovin MAX, SKAdNetwork metadata, privacy manifests, and monetization adapter flows.
* Collaborate with Product, Android, QA, and business stakeholders to align cross-platform behavior, maintain automated testing/release workflows, and deliver SDK features reliably

**What You Will Bring**

* 6+ years of professional iOS development experience, with hands-on SDK development experience.
* Strong recent Objective-C experience, including writing, maintaining, or debugging production Objective-C code.
* Strong Swift experience and solid understanding of Swift/Objective-C interoperability.
* Experience building SDKs or shared libraries consumed by multiple apps or third-party host applications.
* Deep understanding of ARC, GCD, concurrency, memory management, thread safety, and callback handling.
* Understanding of static vs dynamic linking, dependency management, binary distribution, and integration conflicts such as duplicate symbols or class conflicts.
* Experience with SDK packaging and distribution using SPM, CocoaPods, .framework, or .xcframework.
* Ability to troubleshoot SDK integration, performance, crash, and compatibility issues inside host applications.
* Experience with ad tech, mediation SDKs, AppLovin MAX, SKAdNetwork, privacy manifests, or monetization adapters is a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve:

+ Keep healthy through our Apollo Health Check-ups, and stay covered with our Medical Insurance for you and your family
+ Pick what matters most to you in our INR 4100/month Personalized Benefits Platform: Travel, entertainment, food, fitness, and healthcare
+ Have us cover your office lunches 3 times a week through Zomato, and enjoy office sweets, snacks, and beverages
+ Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars, and level up your language skills through our German/English classes
+ Recharge with 19 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays
+ Strengthen team connections while exploring new cultures through our monthly Work&Travel raffle, offering a chance to work from one of our global offices (after 2 years of employment)
+ … and even more reasons to join us!

Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Salesforce Application Engineer, YouTube
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or other technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience coding in one or more of the following programming languages: Python, JavaScript, PHP, Perl, Apex, Java, Django.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer.
* Experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Apex, and working with Salesforce integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), Cloud infrastructure (e.g., GCP), or AI/ML and agentic technologies.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Data Cloud, CRM Analytics (CRMA), or Agentforce/Einstein.
* Exposure to SFDC cross-organization or cross-instance integrations in support of multiple business process environments.
* Exposure to system design or workflow/orchestration frameworks.

**About the job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
As an Application Engineer Salesforce at YouTube, you will be a part of the salesforce-focused engineering team building business systems for the YouTube GTMS T&I Partnership Systems team that is tasked with achieving greater creator satisfaction and success.
  
  
Your work enables our partnership teams to provide strategic, outcomes-focused insights for our top YouTube creators. Outcomes of the team keep the YouTube business organization nimble, able to understand partner needs and innovate accordingly.
  
  
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we share and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, and deploy Salesforce features using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and SOQL, applying established patterns with guidance from senior engineers.
* Build and maintain system integrations and data pipelines connecting Salesforce with Google's internal (1P) and third-party (3P) platforms, writing unit/integration tests and participating in code reviews to maintain foundational code quality alongside vendor teams.
* Support day-to-day release operations, CI/CD deployments, and first-line production incident triage, identifying and escalating technical challenges and contributing to their resolution.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners, product leads, and business system owners to help translate business requirements into technical solutions and clear documentation.
* Manage assigned tasks and priorities effectively, contributing to project goals and milestones with regular guidance and supervision.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: AI Engineer - Mobile Android [T500-30142]
description:
**About Officeworks:**

Officeworks’ purpose is “we bring big ideas to life at low prices”. It’s how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders.

We are Australia’s leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U.

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools.

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organisation where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect.

**About the Data and AI Hub:**

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks’ global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks’ purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence.

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks’ core technology ecosystem.

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:

* Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
* Supporting global initiatives and modernizing business critical systems
* Being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes.

**Why this role exists:**

The Associate AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms and supports by orchestrating AI agents to produce code, tests, and documentation, ensuring features across Officeworks’ digital properties are built and maintained efficiently. The role is a full stack engineering role and bridges feature development and quality assurance by directing agent workflows and conducting critical reviews before code is committed to production.

In addition to feature development, the role contributes to the
**ongoing operation, maintenance, and support of Customer Platforms systems in production**
. This includes monitoring system performance and health, identifying and resolving production issues, supporting incident and defect resolution, and implementing fixes and enhancements to ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of digital platforms

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Agent Workstream Orchestration:**

* Run single or paired agent workstreams across coding, test generation, and documentation workflows.
* Translate technical and product specifications into precise, structured instructions for AI agents to execute.
* Apply platform context, base coding standards, and security policies to every agent execution.
* Monitor parallel agent tasks and confirm that generated outputs satisfy specified functional requirements.

**Code Review and Quality Assurance:**

* Perform rigorous reviews of agent-generated code, automated tests, and technical documentation.
* Design and execute test cases across unit, integration, and end-to-end scenarios, extending beyond AI-generated coverage where gaps exist.
* Evaluate generated code for functional correctness, security vulnerabilities, performance, and architectural fit.
* Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, escalating severity and blockers to Senior AI Engineers where required.

**Documentation and Shared Context Management:**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to ensure context repositories effectively feed subsequent agent runs.
* Identify and resolve missing, outdated, or ambiguous context in shared repositories that negatively affects agent accuracy.
* Log technical decisions and specification updates to maintain end-to-end trace abilities for system workflows.

**Operational Support and Issue Resolution:**

* Support the investigation and resolution of production issues across the platform domains managed by the pod.
* Participate in on-call support rotations as required to maintain platform reliability and system availability.
* Support release verification and post-deployment checks to confirm features perform as tested before hyper care handover.
* Track runtime anomalies or recurring defects and feed learnings back into context documentation and agent guidance.

**Who you will be working with:**

* Pod Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to translate specifications into executable agent workflows and deliver features in continuous flow.
* Platform and Architecture Specialists: Work with Context Engineers, Solution Architects, and Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers to align work with base contexts, security policies, and review frameworks.
* Operations and Enablement Teams: Collaborate with Platform Engineers, Associate AI Agent Operations Engineers, and the AI Enablement Manager to leverage shared tools, continuous integration pipelines, and observability platforms.
* Vendor and External Partners: Engage with external vendor support and technology partners as directed to resolve tooling issues or platform integration requirements.

**What success looks like:**

* Delivery Velocity and Quality: High review pass rate on submitted code and test artefacts, with minimal defects escaping to production environments.
* Capability Progression: Demonstrated growth in independent review judgement, prompt engineering literacy, and agent orchestration.
* Artefact Currency: High accuracy and completeness of shared context repositories and technical documentation contributed to the pod.
* Operational Resilience: Timely response to and resolution of domain incidents, maintaining reliable and secure platform performance.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How you will lead:**

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 3+ years of software engineering experience, with exposure to

title: Solutions Architect  - LCNC Platform
description:
**Solutions Architect – LCNC Platform**

**Experience:**
**2–4 years**

**Location : Bangalore**

**Role overview**

The Solutions Architect is the technical owner of GIVA’s workflow team: they design how each application should work and then build it themselves on the low-code / no-code (LCNC) platform. They work directly with business teams to understand how processes run today, then turn agreed requirements into data models, approval logic, integrations and dashboards that run day-to-day operations across retail, supply chain, merchandising, finance and HR.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll own each workflow end to end, from mapping the process with the business team to building and supporting the solution, while also setting the standards, integration patterns and guardrails that keep the platform maintainable as it grows.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Process discovery and requirements**

* Partner with Retail Operations, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Finance and HR to find manual spreadsheets, email-based approvals and other operational bottlenecks.
* Run discovery workshops and map current (AS-IS) and improved (TO-BE) processes.
* Write requirement documents, user stories and acceptance criteria sized for rapid LCNC delivery, covering data fields, validation rules, SLA escalations and permissions.
* Use wireframes, swimlanes or quick prototypes to agree on the design with business teams before building.
* Assess incoming automation requests for business value, and decide whether the CoE builds them or the business team builds them as a self-serve workflow.
* Drive adoption after launch: train end users, track usage and plan enhancements.

**2. Solution and data design**

* Translate agreed requirements into application designs: data models, business rule tables, approval matrices and multi-step workflow logic.
* Define role-based access control (RBAC) and field- and row-level security for every application.
* Design data flows so that core systems (ERP, POS, WMS, Shopify) remain the systems of record, while operational workflows run on the LCNC layer.

**3. Application build and configuration**

* Build responsive web and mobile apps using the platform’s visual builders and workflow modules.
* Create dynamic forms with conditional visibility, formulas, validations and OCR / document-processing components.
* Configure sequential and parallel approvals, SLA timers, auto-escalations and conditional branching.
* Set up external portals for vendors, suppliers and retail partners, with appropriate security controls.

**4. Integrations and scripting**

* Build bi-directional integrations with internal and third-party systems using pre-built connectors, REST APIs and webhooks.
* Write lightweight scripts (JavaScript or Python) for data transformations, calculations and advanced validations.

**5. Reporting and dashboards**

* Build operational status boards, KPI dashboards and drill-down reports for business teams and leadership.
* Keep layouts and UI patterns consistent across applications on desktop and mobile.

**6. Governance and standards**

* Set up and maintain CoE guardrails: reusable templates and components, naming conventions, and Dev / UAT / Prod release management.
* Review applications, including those built by citizen developers, for data integrity, security and performance before they go live.

**7. Testing, rollout and support**

* Test components, functions and integrations in staging before promoting to production, then lead UAT with business users, track defects and get sign-off.
* Resolve user-reported issues, improve workflow performance and ship iterative enhancements based on user feedback.
* Give departmental citizen developers reusable building blocks, technical guidance and troubleshooting support.

**Required qualifications and core skills**

* **Experience:**
  **2–4 years**
  of hands-on development on low-code platforms, business process automation, or full-stack development, including some experience gathering requirements and designing solutions end to end rather than only building to someone else’s specification.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or a related field. Equivalent hands-on experience with low-code platforms will also be considered.
* **Process analysis:**
  Experience running requirement workshops and mapping processes (BPMN, swimlanes, AS-IS / TO-BE), and breaking operations such as procure-to-pay, inventory exceptions or store onboarding into clear workflow steps.
* **APIs and integration:**
  Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and OAuth2; comfortable testing integrations with tools like Postman.
* **Data:**
  Good grasp of relational data modelling, normalisation and basic SQL / NoSQL queries.
* **Scripting:**
  Solid fundamentals in JavaScript or Python, plus basic HTML and CSS.
* **Security:**
  Practical understanding of RBAC, SSO and audit requirements for business applications.
* **Process logic:**
  Clear thinking about business conditions, approval loops, state changes and error handling.
* **Speed with judgement:**
  Can ship a working prototype in days, while knowing when a shortcut will create technical debt later.
* **Communication:**
  Comfortable explaining technical trade-offs to business users and working directly with them in requirement and UAT sessions.

**Preferred platform experience**

* Hands-on build experience on one or more low-code platforms such as Microsoft Power Apps (Canvas / Model-Driven), Power Automate, Zoho Creator, Mendix, OutSystems, Appian or ServiceNow.
* Experience integrating with retail or e-commerce systems (Shopify, POS, ERP, WMS) is a strong plus.

description:

**Role Type - Full Time**
**The opportunity**
We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Risk and Compliance Engineering Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Risk Management, Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
  
  
We’re looking for a Full-stack Engineer (front-end focussed) at EY GDS. You will work on designing and implementing modern web applications with a focus on front-end development using Angular or React.js with TypeScript. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build, deploy, and manage scalable back-end services, APIs, and database integrations that meet business needs and leverage best practices in full-stack development and cloud technologies. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering. We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial and non-financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective.
  
  
EY Risk and Compliance Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Engineering (RCE) practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s RCE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Front-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain front-end applications using React.js with TypeScript.
* API Integration: Work with REST APIs and GraphQL services for data integration.

* Experience with Python, or Node.js for back-end development and frameworks such as FastAPI, Django or ExpressJS

* Experience in containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with one of the cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Experience with version control systems, particularly Git

* Domain: Prior experience in the Financial Services / FS Risk domain.
* Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues

**Education**
:
  
  
**Degree**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. title: Power Apps Tech Lead
description:
**Power Apps Tech Lead— Canvas Apps, Power Automate & Dataverse**
**Location**
Bengaluru / Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience**
7–12 years in application development, with strong hands-on experience building intuitive Power Apps canvas apps, designing scalable Power Automate workflows, and implementing Dataverse solutions including the security model — plus working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities into Power Platform solutions
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is seeking a Power Apps Tech Lead to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade solutions across Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse. This is a hands-on build role for someone who takes a business process and turns it into a canvas app people find easy and fast to use, backed by a properly designed Dataverse model and automation that holds up in production.
  
  
You will own features end to end — data model, app, automation, integration and security — on delivery teams alongside architects, business analysts and client stakeholders. We also expect you to bring AI into the solution where it earns its place: embedding Copilot and agent capabilities in canvas apps and the wider Power Platform estate, rather than treating AI as a separate project.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build intuitive, user-friendly Power Apps canvas apps — screen and navigation design, responsive layouts, reusable components, delegation-aware data access and performance tuning.
* Turn business requirements and user journeys into working applications, taking ownership of usability and of how the app performs with real data volumes.
* Design and implement scalable Power Automate workflows — cloud flows, child flows, error handling and retry patterns, approvals, scheduled and event-driven processing, and concurrency and throughput considerations.
* Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules.
* Design and implement the Dataverse security model — security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security — and validate that users see only what they should.
* Integrate AI agents and Copilot capabilities into canvas apps and related Power Platform solutions, including Copilot Studio agents, AI Builder models and prompt-based actions, with attention to grounding, accuracy and appropriate use.
* Integrate solutions with external systems and Microsoft 365 services using standard and custom connectors, Power Automate and APIs.
* Apply Power Platform ALM properly — solutions, managed and unmanaged layers, environment variables, connection references, and deployment through pipelines or Azure DevOps.
* Troubleshoot, tune and resolve defects across apps, flows and Dataverse, including performance and delegation issues.
* Follow Power Platform governance, licensing, data loss prevention and security best practice, and design within the client’s environment strategy.
* Produce technical documentation, solution designs and handover material, and support testing, UAT, deployment and release activities.
* Work with business stakeholders, architects and developers to shape practical solutions, and guide junior developers on the team.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7–12 years of overall application development experience, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Strong hands-on experience building Power Apps canvas apps that users find intuitive — component reuse, responsive design, Power Fx, collections and variables, delegation and performance optimisation.
* Strong experience designing and implementing scalable Power Automate workflows, including error handling, child flows, approvals and long-running or high-volume patterns.
* Proven Dataverse implementation experience: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules.
* Practical command of the Dataverse security model — security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security — and the ability to design it for a real organizational structure.
* Working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities with canvas apps and Power Platform solutions (Copilot Studio, AI Builder or equivalent).
* Experience integrating with external systems and Microsoft 365 services through standard and custom connectors and APIs.
* Understanding of Power Platform ALM — solutions, environment variables, connection references and automated deployment.
* Awareness of Power Platform governance, licensing implications and DLP policies.
* Ability to debug and performance-tune apps and flows, and to resolve defects through to closure.
* Good client-facing communication — running requirement discussions and demos, and explaining design decisions clearly.

**Qualifications**
**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Experience with model-driven apps, Power Pages or Power BI alongside canvas apps.
* Experience building Copilot Studio agents in depth — topics, actions, knowledge sources and channel deployment.
* Custom code extension skills: PCF components, JavaScript, C# plug-ins or Azure Functions.
* Azure integration experience — Logic Apps, API Management, Key Vault or Service Bus.
* Microsoft certifications: PL-400, PL-200, PL-600 or AI-102.
* Experience with Dataverse data migration and integration tooling (dataflows, Azure Data Factory, Data Migration Utility).
* Experience with Dynamics 365 applications on the same Dataverse platform.
* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar), including presales or demo support.
* Prior contribution to reusable components, accelerators or practice IP.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience with Salesforce Platform Events, Change Data Capture, asynchronous Apex, middleware, or event-driven integrations.
